lead.headline: The federal housing agency pays $2,574 a unit a month for White Birch Apartments in Milwaukee: 223% of fair rent
lead.number: $2,574 a unit a month, 223% of fair rent for its bedroom mix; no other 100+ unit building in a cheap market outside Puerto Rico runs a higher ratio.
lead.watch_out: Two tax-credit deals in seven years (2017 FHA purchase, May 2024 new owner) fit a legal rent reset.
